# Deepu Siva Private Limited

> Deepu Siva Private Limited is an industrial engineering, metal fabrication, structural and solar solutions company based in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India.

## Canonical website
- https://deepusiva.com/

## Company facts
- Business name: Deepu Siva Private Limited
- Location: Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 84890 90666
- Email: contact@deepusiva.com
- Primary language: English (India)
- Founder mentioned on the website: Rajavel Palaniyappan, founder of D.S. Electricals

## Services
- Industrial Engineering
- Metal Fabrication
- PEB & Industrial Structures
- Solar Structures
- Solar Installation
- Industrial Roofing

## Solar tools
- Solar Tools hub: https://deepusiva.com/solar-tools.html
- Solar Potential Simulator: https://deepusiva.com/solar-potential-map.html
  - Uses location-based Open-Meteo weather data. Shows previous 30 days of sunshine data and a 7-day forecast, then estimates generation for a selected system size.
- Solar Cost & Savings Calculator: https://deepusiva.com/solar-calculator.html
  - Uses customer-entered electricity consumption and tariff to estimate system size, panel count, indicative cost, savings and payback.
- Government Scheme Timer: https://deepusiva.com/scheme-timer.html
  - Displays the published PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana implementation period and links to official sources.

## Project workflow
1. Discover the requirement, site and objective.
2. Engineer the practical solution and scope.
3. Fabricate the required components.
4. Coordinate delivery and logistics.
5. Install or erect at site.
6. Complete the agreed scope and handover.
